Executive summary

A config push at 21:07 UTC replaced the notification fanout topic ARN with a self-referencing ARN. Every published event was re-consumed by its own publisher, multiplying once per loop with a 3-second period. The blast-radius guardrail existed but was disabled by the same push. Customer-visible symptom: notification storms, up to twelve forty-one duplicates per tenant. No data loss; no unauthorized access. Recovery was manual because the kill switch lived behind the same misconfigured deploy.

Our phones buzzed forty times in ten minutes. We thought we were being attacked; it turned out we were being congratulated, repeatedly, for yesterday's deployment. — Head of Platform, customer #4471 (tenant apne1-88, name withheld)

What broke, exactly

fanout-loop flame graph (3s loop, 21:07→21:47)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────
publish            ██████████████████████████████  29.1s  9,701 msg/s
 ├ consume         ██████████████████████████████  self ARN matched
 │  ├ deserialize  ████                            3.8s
 │  ├ route:match  ██████████████████████████████  ← 100% self-route (bug)
 │  └ publish      ██████████████████████████████  re-enters publish
 └ metrics.emit    █                               0.9s  (looked healthy!)
# the offending layer, redacted
fanout:
  topic_arn: ${NOTIFY_TOPIC}          # resolved to… itself
  max_redeliver: 0                    # guardrail disabled by this diff
  self_probe:
    enabled: true
    interval: 3s
    expect_deliveries: 1              # probe passed by feeding itself

The health check worked as written: it expected exactly one delivery and got it, from itself. Monitoring stayed green for the entire incident because probe_status == ok was the alert that mattered most.

Action items

  • Guardrail flags may not ship in the same diff as the feature they guard — CI check. owner: dae-hyun · due 2026-09-12 · P0
  • Self-probe health checks validate against a separate probe topic, never production. owner: yuki · due 2026-09-19 · P0
  • Rollback path must not share config layers with forward deploys. owner: amara · due 2026-09-26 · P1
  • Add duplication-ratio alert independent of probe status. owner: yuki · done 2026-09-04 · P0 ✅

Honest smaller number: the full fix is a CI check and a topic rename — a day of work. A fanout rewrite was discussed and is not part of this plan.
